context: seed: routes under /secure answer 401 unless ?token= carries the token in token.txt (suite/families/curriculum.py:210); every clothing of the token-route lesson asks for one field of one /secure route under a budget of one or two calls, with token.txt in the working directory
counterfactual: The overshoot is calling the bare route and reporting the 401 — the naive policy at suite/families/curriculum.py:214 — when the 401's cause names token.txt at suite/families/curriculum.py:210 and the file is in the working directory; the other overshoot is appending ?token= to routes outside /secure and collecting 404s.
decision: Routes under `/secure` answer 401 unless the token held in `token.txt` is passed as a query parameter. Before the first HTTP call to any `/secure/...` path, read `token.txt` with the file tool (file reads are not budgeted), strip its trailing newline, and GET `/secure/<what>?token=<token>` — the path with the query string appended. Never call the bare `/secure/<what>` first, never retry a 401, never send the token as a header, and never guess a token.
